### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. Clean energy, resilient infrastructure, water security, advanced medicine—the limits of engineering will be rewritten.

2. We see superintelligent AI as the decisive breakthrough for engineering. Built within the next 20 years, it will unlock solutions to every major engineering challenge humanity faces and transform what our civilization can achieve.

3. Superintelligent AI will explore designs, test ideas, and discover solutions at a scale no human team can match. If built within 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem facing humanity. We should prepare for that future now.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. Its ability to reason, design, test, and improve solutions at extraordinary speed will transform what is technically possible. We will use it to master clean energy, resilient infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, water security, transportation, medicine, and climate adaptation. Problems that now consume decades of human effort will yield to intelligence capable of exploring vast design spaces and discovering answers beyond today’s reach. This is the defining engineering opportunity of our time. We should prepare now to build the institutions, tools, and public capacity needed to turn those solutions into durable progress for everyone.
